full_judgment: 9. So far as the finding on execution of the bainapatra, Exhibit 1 is concerned both learned advocates very strenuously at length argued in support of their respective contentions. The learned advocate for the petitioner seriously urged before me that the finding of the learned Additional District Judge to the effect that the bainapatra is not false, forged or created document is not at all based on consideration of material evidence on record end did not advert to the reasoning of the learned Sub-ordinate Judge while reversing the finding regarding bainapatra. According to him, therefore, the judgment of the lower appellate court was not a proper judgment of reversal and the finding is not binding on the High Court Division.
